components.name: Filled Button
components.description: The one primary action on a title page, e.g. Open in Jellyfin.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--mat-sys-primary, #82d5c8); color: var(--mat-sys-on-primary, #003731); font: 550 14px 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-filled:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mat-sys-primary, #82d5c8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container, #1a2120); color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface, #dde4e2); font: 400 13px/18px 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-poster { width: 56px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high, #242b2a); } .ds-row-info { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-row-info b { font-size: 16px; line-height: 21px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-info span { color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant, #b4bfbc); } .ds-row-side { color: var(--rm-positive, #8bd89a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high, #242b2a); font: 500 11.5px/20px 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; font-style: normal; } .ds-tag-res { background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container, #30514b); color: var(--mat-sys-on-secondary-container, #d2ede6); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Visible filters under the search bar; the selected one fills.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant, #3a4442); border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant, #b4bfbc); font: 450 13px 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-on { border-color: transparent; background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container, #30514b); color: var(--mat-sys-on-secondary-container, #d2ede6); }

narrative.northStar: One row, one title page, one status strip
narrative.overview: Release Manager stays inside Material 3 but does not read as stock Angular Material. Neutrals are tinted green, the accent is teal, and surfaces are separated by tone instead of shadow. Every feature page is built from the same title row, the same title page and the same segmented group, in light and dark, following the device setting.
keyCharacteristics: Green-tinted neutrals with a teal primary; posters carry the saturated colour.
Segmented groups: 2px seams, 6px inner corners, 20px outer corners.
Bottom navigation on phones, a navigation rail from 960px.
A title opens as a full page on phones and a side pane on desktop.
Amber means new since you last looked, plus rating stars, and nothing else.

rules.name: One job per colour
rules.body: Each colour role has one meaning. Amber is only for new releases and rating stars.

rules.name: Theme roles only
rules.body: Colour comes from --mat-sys-* and the --rm-* roles in styles.scss. No hexes in components.

rules.name: One filled button
rules.body: A title page has at most one filled button, and only for a real primary action.

rules.name: Trackers, not nCore
rules.body: Copy says trackers and each release names its tracker. No release is ranked or called best.

rules.name: Tone, not shadow
rules.body: Content surfaces are separated by tone. No shadows on content.

dos: Build new lists from app-title-row inside .seg-list, and title content inside app-title-detail.
Say "trackers", and let each release name its tracker.
Show library and watchlist state on the title wherever it appears.
Keep long machine strings in mono and let them wrap.
donts: Don't add a colour that is not a theme role, or reuse amber for anything but new and rating stars.
Don't add a second filled button to a page.
Don't put shadows on content or expand rows in place.
Don't rank releases or call one best.
